page.overview:
What is Transforming Ability?

A user of the ability is capable of creating new forms for themselves by growing and altering their Bio Suit. The transformations also have some alteration to the user's voice with each state.

Frieza's clan has displayed the ability to create up to three transformations that suppress their true power. The user may wish to use this ability to hide their full strength, or because they cannot fully control their abilities in their natural form.

They can then freely release more and more power, going through less suppressive states until returning to their natural form as necessary. As such, the natural form is not included in this list due to not counting as an actual transformation.

Frieza's clan seemingly create their suppression transformations by growing a power suppressing Bio Suit over their true form, and then altering and shedding it as they see fit to increase their power back up. In Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection ‘F’, Frieza trained to be able to return to his proper form from his first form, rather than taking longer to do so by going through his second and third forms as well. First Form: Utilized by Frieza, Frost and Kuriza. It is also stated that Cooler possesses this form.
